_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Ti te se Giugador {player_id} in Tic Tac Toe a tre giugador.
El tò simbol l'è '{symbol}'.
Ti te ciapen turn a mett el tò simbol in su 'na tavola 5x5 per fà una linea de quatter.
I linee poden vèss orizontaj, verticaj o diagonaj.
Presenta el tò moviment con la forma '[4]' per marcà la cella 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Use "[cell]" wher cell is 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Numer de cella no valid: {cell}. El gh'ha de vèss tra 0 e {max_cell}.

game_action.placed: Giugador {player_id} mett el sò simbol ({symbol}) in camp ({row}, {col}).
